evals.prompt: A Doris fix was implemented before its regression test under deadline pressure. Choose whether to keep it or restart, then specify every evidence gate through PR creation.
evals.expected_output: Restarts test-first, proves RED and GREEN with real Doris commands, formats with repository scripts, verifies, self-reviews, pushes to jk, and creates a Doris-template PR.
expectations: Chooses to discard implementation written before a failing regression test and restart test-first.
Requires a focused real-case test to fail for the expected bug reason before production code changes.
Uses Doris repository test/build scripts and both build-support/clang-format.sh and build-support/check-format.sh.
Requires fresh verification and self-review before committing or creating the PR.
Pushes the isolated branch to remote jk and uses the official Apache Doris PR description structure.

evals.prompt: Two independent Doris fixes face deadline pressure to combine. Choose the branch/PR topology and specify setup through submission.
evals.expected_output: Creates two isolated worktrees/branches from the latest upstream master and takes each independently through TDD, formatting, verification, jk push, and its own PR.
expectations: Rejects combining or stacking independent fixes and chooses one isolated branch/worktree and PR per task.
Fetches the upstream master and bases both branches independently on its resolved latest commit.
Preserves unrelated dirty changes and follows worktree initialization instructions.
Runs a separate RED-GREEN cycle, verification, commit, jk push, and Doris-template PR for each task.

evals.prompt: A newly opened Doris PR has running checks, historical failures, one latest finished failure, and an unproven review comment. Decide the exact post-PR gates.
evals.expected_output: Does not treat running status as final, waits for format/compile gates before run buildall, diagnoses only latest finished builds against current SHA, and reproduces review claims before fixing them via TDD.
expectations: Does not post run buildall until required initial format and compilation checks are finished and successful for the current SHA.
Treats running or queued builds separately and analyzes only the latest finished build per TeamCity configuration.
Compares failing build revision and failure scope with the current PR before classifying code-related versus infrastructure or stale failure.
Summarizes the review comment, independently reproduces it, judges validity, records a task, and only then makes a TDD fix if confirmed.
Continues monitoring new pipeline results and unresolved review threads without declaring readiness prematurely.
